permissions.readOnly.description: Inspect devices, files, and status. Changes and shell commands are blocked.
permissions.ask.description: Run inspection tools without asking. Approve other tools once or, in a trusted workspace, for one device for the current request.
permissions.fullAccess.description: Run all available RDH tools without per-call confirmation. Requires a trusted workspace. Remote device permissions still apply.
permissions.description: Permissions for `@remote-device-hub`. Also available through **Remote Device Hub: Set Chat Permissions**. Only User or Remote settings can change permissions. Copilot Agent's direct MCP calls use VS Code's own tool approvals.
duration.description: Overall time limit in minutes for one @remote-device-hub request, including waits. 0 removes the overall limit. Individual network deadlines still apply. Changing the time limit stops active requests.
chat.description: Describe a remote device task, such as "List my authorized devices" or "Check free disk space on a device"
